# Export fixtures (SYNTHETIC)

Every file in this directory is **synthetic**. The values are a smooth 24 h curve plus seeded
random noise, generated by [`make_fixtures.py`](make_fixtures.py) (seed `20261005`); nothing
here is a measurement of a real sensor. The serial numbers only give the files realistic names.

**Exception:** [`real/`](real/README.md) holds a trimmed **real** export of sensor 77799986
(public by owner decision 2026-10-05). It is not generated and has its own README.

The file layouts were reconstructed from the legacy scripts (`generate_animation.py`,
`chrome_driver.py`, `sampl_freq_basic.py`, `vineyard_analyst.py`). The portal CSV layout has
since been confirmed by the real export in `real/`; the real file additionally has
precipitation and battery columns, newest-first rows and a trailing `;` line. The XLSX layouts
are still unverified (owner question Q11). See `docs/data-format.md`.

Regenerate (from the project root):

```bash
.venv/bin/python tests/fixtures/exports/make_fixtures.py
```

`tests/ingest/test_fixtures.py` checks that the committed files equal the generator output
(CSV byte for byte, workbooks cell by cell, because the ZIP container stores write times).
